2608.16333.title: Step-Level On-Policy Distillation: Interpolating Between On-Policy Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning
2608.16333.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) aligns a student model with a teacher's logit distribution on student-generated trajectories. This approach has achieved strong empirical gains and can often surpass conventional off-policy distillation with substantially less data. However, standard token-level OPD can provide only fragmented corrections along an erroneous student trajectory and cannot unfold a complete and correct repair path. Motivated by this limitation, we propose \emph{Step-Level On-Policy Distillation} (SOPD), which combines the long-horizon correction of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with the on-policy advantage of OPD to provide step-level supervision over complete student-generated trajectories. We show that, at different limits of step length, SOPD reduces to SFT or approximates OPD. Compared with SFT, the teacher responses in SOPD are conditioned on student trajectories and therefore align more closely with student-visited states; compared with OPD, SOPD provides longer-horizon corrections rather than fragmented token-level guidance. Across both reasoning and agent tasks, SOPD substantially outperforms conventional SFT and OPD. For example, on ALFWorld, SOPD improves the average success rate by 13.4 points over Vanilla OPD. We hope this work offers a new perspective for future research on distillation methods.
2608.16333.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，學生模型與教師的邏輯分佈在學生生成的軌跡上對齊。這種方法已經取得了強大的實證增益，並且通常可以在數據量大幅減少的情況下超越傳統的離線政策蒸餾。然而，標準的標記級 OPD 只能在錯誤的學生軌跡上提供片段修正，無法展開完整且正確的修復路徑。受到這一限制的啟發，我們提出了 \emph{步驟級政策蒸餾}（SOPD），它結合了監督微調（SFT）的長期修正和 OPD 的在線優勢，為完整的學生生成軌跡提供步驟級的監督。我們顯示，在不同的步長極限下，SOPD 簡化為 SFT 或近似 OPD。與 SFT 相比，SOPD 中的教師反應是基於學生軌跡的，因此與學生訪問的狀態更為一致；與 OPD 相比，SOPD 提供的是長期修正，而不是片段的標記級指導。在推理和代理任務中，SOPD 明顯超越了傳統的 SFT 和 OPD。例如，在 ALFWorld 上，SOPD 將平均成功率提高了 13.4 個百分點，相較於 Vanilla OPD。我們希望這項工作能為未來的蒸餾方法研究提供新的視角。
